entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I received a few weeks ago. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF-PULSE-99482.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's no fault, it works great. It's just a preference issue. I thought I would use the advanced features more than I do, and it's just not the right fit for my routine. I'd prefer to return it if possible.
I understand completely. Sometimes a new device just doesn't click. Let me just review our return policy for you to confirm the eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked the information, and according to our company policy, you're well within the return window.
Oh, you're sure? I thought I might be too late.
Not at all. The policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you have plenty of time. We can definitely process a full refund for you. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now.
That's fantastic! I really appreciate that. I was worried I'd have to try and sell it.

No need for that. The email is on its way. Just pack the band back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed in 5-7 business days.
Perfect. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You are very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
